entries.title: Evidence stays for a task that carries work on
entries.body: A closed task's evidence folder is kept past its week while another task carries its work on, or retries it with a stronger model, so that task can still read the earlier pictures and logs. It goes a week after the earlier task closed, once no open task still needs it.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes; the evidence folder simply stays on disk for longer.
